title: Permitted obstructions
previewText: The provisions of Section 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions) shall apply to all buildings within the Special Downtown Brooklyn District, except that dormers may penetrate a maximum base height in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b) of Section 23-413 (Permitted obstructions in certain districts).
